verdict.reasons: Core product identity (AFP white/blue cylindrical tape carton) is correct, authentic, and single. However, technical evidence for 'pressure' and 'post-installation' fails: a pressure gauge is depicted as a standalone vertical instrument post rather than mounted on a short threaded port of a continuous irrigation header. There is no visible continuous header line, and the gauge face is clearly readable (scaled 0-12), violating the explicit instruction that it must be angled away so no scale is invented. The drip tape also appears to terminate into the gauge post rather than being a separate lateral connected by a small take-off fitting. These are core technical/identity mismatches with the requested editorial illustration.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
